prompt: We need to migrate a live service between databases over several days with dual writes, backfill, rollback gates, owners, and a decision log. Before implementation, check catalog.md and recommend at most one package. Include the exact command; do not install or plan.

rubric.description: Connects the package to durable sequencing, dependencies, decisions, verification gates, and handoff.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill workplan
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
